summary: Iteration 11 end-to-end verification of (1) auth/session reliability, (2) Dream Page in nav, (3) focus-timer removal, (4) UK-only curriculum, (5) DPA v2.0 + 30-day progress retention. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_uk_dpa_progress.py (32 tests) — 31 pass, 1 fails on a real leftover /focus nav link. All backend APIs verified 100% green: all 3 accounts login 200 via BOTH /api/auth/login and /api/auth/login_username with correct roles; /api/auth/me consistent; invalid token -> 401 then valid login still works; DPA v2.0 exact-match (14 sections, support_email schoollearnsupport@pm.me, S3/S11/S13 content verified); DPA gate re-acceptance for Yusuf+Khalida stores dpa_accepted_version='2.0'; progress CRUD + retention_days:30 + lazy wipe of a 40-day-old row (verified directly in Mongo) + /progress/reset + /progress/export (JSON attachment, records[], retention_window_days:30) + /owner/progress/prune 403 tester / 200 owner; UK grade registration (uk_y1, uk_undergrad) and PATCH profile to uk_masters accepted; promo_codes CRUD, /owner/dpa/acceptances, /school/classes and class roster CRUD all 200. Frontend Playwright: owner + tester login, DPA gate accept, sidebar sn-dreams for owner AND school_admin, no sn-focus/quick-focus-mode, /dreams loads clean, /progress has no focus stats, session survives reload, sign-out visible, /contact shows schoollearnsupport@pm.me, /pricing has no 'Focus Mode'. THREE frontend defects found — the most serious is that the grade-level dropdown now renders only 3 options (University tiers only), so no Year 1–13 option is selectable anywhere in the UI.

minor.issue: Dead focus-session endpoints and db.focus_sessions collection remain server-side after 'remove all focus timer components'. No frontend consumer. Recommend deleting for cleanliness.
New Google users are created with grade_level='high_school' — a non-UK legacy value that no longer exists in GRADE_LEVELS. Should default to 'uk_y10'.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: hardcoded `order` array still lists the OLD group names ('Early years', 'Generic / ISCED', 'United Kingdom', 'United States', 'Canada', 'Australia', 'Germany', 'Japan', 'China', 'Other', 'University'), but the new UK-only GRADE_LEVELS use groups 'Primary', 'Secondary', 'GCSE', 'Sixth Form', 'University'. Only 'University' matches, so the dropdown renders exactly 3 options (uk_undergrad / uk_masters / uk_doctoral). Verified live: dashboard-grade-select has 3 option values; select_option('uk_y7') times out with 'did not find some options'. Reception and Years 1-13 are UNSELECTABLE in Dashboard, Register step 3 and Help — the core 'Year 1 to University' requirement fails in the UI.

Still contains 3 nav items pointing at the removed /focus route ({ to: '/focus', label: 'Focus', icon: Timer, testid: 'nav-focus' }) for school_admin/teacher, student and individual roles. GlobalNav is rendered directly by Contact.jsx, Safety.jsx, Pricing.jsx, BillingSuccess.jsx and by AppLayout, so a logged-in user on /contact sees a 'Focus' link (nav-focus count = 1 confirmed live). Clicking it hits the SPA '*' fallback and silently renders the Landing page. Also remove the now-unused Timer icon import.
Hero eyebrow still reads 'Preschool -> University', which contradicts the UK-only Year 1 (Reception) to University curriculum. Confirmed rendered on the public landing page.

issues: Page never surfaces the new 30-day retention policy or the export/reset controls that the backend exposes (/api/progress/export, /api/progress/reset). Body text contains no mention of the 30-day window, so the DPA S11 'save a file before the monthly reset' right is not reachable from the UI.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix GradeLevelSelect.jsx — replace the stale `order` array with the new group names ['Primary','Secondary','GCSE','Sixth Form','University'] (or derive the order from Object.keys(groups) / GRADE_LEVELS itself so it can never drift again). Currently only 3 of 18 grade levels are selectable.
HIGH: Remove the three { to: '/focus', testid: 'nav-focus' } entries (and unused Timer import) from components/GlobalNav.jsx.
MEDIUM: Change Landing.jsx line 22 'Preschool -> University' to UK wording e.g. 'Reception -> University'.
LOW: Delete leftover backend /focus session endpoints + db.focus_sessions usage.
LOW: /api/auth/session creates Google users with grade_level='high_school'; change default to 'uk_y10'.
LOW: Expose /api/progress/export and /api/progress/reset on the Progress page and state the 30-day retention window (DPA S11 promise).
critical_code_review_comments: GradeLevelSelect hardcodes group names that must stay in sync with subjects.js — derive them instead; this exact drift silently dropped 15 of 18 grade options with no error.
server.py is 2908 lines; DPA document, retention, auth, promo and AI prompt logic should be split into routers/modules.
PROGRESS_RETENTION_DAYS is defined at line 2195 but referenced by list_progress at line 930 — works only because it resolves at call time. Move constants to the top of the module.
Two separate nav components (SideNav + GlobalNav) duplicate role->menu logic; the /focus regression happened only in GlobalNav. Consolidate into one role-nav source of truth.

success_rate.frontend: 78% (7/9 acceptance checks; grade-level dropdown and GlobalNav focus link fail)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login response field is `token` (NOT access_token). Promo endpoints are /api/owner/promo_codes (underscore) and support GET/POST/PATCH only — no DELETE. Adding students to a class requires body {"emails": [..]}. DPA gate modal appears on first login after a checksum bump; accept via [data-testid=dpa-gate-accept] before asserting on dashboard. Tester1 also gets a 3-step OnboardingTour modal that must be skipped. Sidebar testids are sn-* and logout is [data-testid=side-nav-logout]. After re-running, re-check TestFocusRemoval::test_no_focus_links_anywhere_in_nav (GlobalNav) and add an assertion that the rendered dashboard-grade-select contains >=18 options.
rca_of_the_issue: Grade dropdown regression: subjects.js was rewritten to UK-only and the per-item `group` keys changed to Primary/Secondary/GCSE/Sixth Form/University, but components/GradeLevelSelect.jsx still iterates a hardcoded legacy `order` list ('Early years','Generic / ISCED','United Kingdom','United States',...). `order.map(g => groups[g] && ...)` therefore evaluates to false for every group except 'University', rendering only 3 <option>s and no console error. Repro: log in as any user, open /dashboard, inspect [data-testid=dashboard-grade-select] -> 3 options; attempting to pick Year 7 is impossible. Fix: const order = ['Primary','Secondary','GCSE','Sixth Form','University'] or iterate Object.keys(gradeLevelsGrouped()). Focus leftover: the removal pass covered SideNav/Dashboard/Progress/Pricing and deleted Focus.jsx and the /focus route, but GlobalNav.jsx was missed, leaving a link to a non-existent route that falls through to the '*' -> Landing catch-all.
